connexion.explication: Enter your email address: you will receive a link to sign in, without a password.
connexion.envoye: If this address has access to amend.ink, a link has just been sent to it. It is valid for 15 minutes.

dev.explication: Development version: choose a name, no email or password.

document.confirmerSuppression: Delete this document for everyone, permanently?
document.exportEchoue: The export failed. Please try again in a moment.
document.connexionPerdue: The connection to this document was closed. Reload the page.
document.droitsChanges: Your access to this document changed: it reopens accordingly.
document.restaurerTexte: The document goes back to this version for everyone. The current state stays in the history (“Before restore”).

erreurs.modele-impossible: This layout template is impossible: its lines, page number or text width do not fit on the page.
erreurs.document-trop-long: This document name is too long (64 characters at most).
erreurs.document-caracteres: A document name may only contain unaccented letters and digits, hyphens and underscores.
erreurs.nom-trop-long: This name is too long (80 characters at most).
erreurs.nom-caracteres: This name contains invisible or control characters.
erreurs.reseau: The server is not responding. Check your connection.
erreurs.ancre-invalide: This comment could not be attached to the text: select a passage within a single paragraph, then try again. Your comment is kept.
erreurs.ancre-vide: First select the passage to comment on. Your comment is kept.
erreurs.ancre-perimee: The passage changed while you were writing: select it again, then try again. Your comment is kept.
erreurs.bloc-introuvable: The passage changed while you were writing: select it again, then try again. Your comment is kept.
erreurs.document-introuvable: This document does not exist, or you do not have access to it.
erreurs.courriel-trop-long: This email address is too long.
erreurs.courriel-invalide: This email address is not valid.
erreurs.droit-insuffisant: You are not allowed to do this on this document.
erreurs.dernier-proprietaire: A document always keeps at least one owner.
erreurs.trop-de-liens: Too many links requested: try again in fifteen minutes.
erreurs.origine-refusee: Request refused: it does not come from amend.ink.
erreurs.collaboration-indisponible: The collaboration service is not responding. Try again.
erreurs.lien-invalide: This sign-in link is no longer valid: ask for a new one.
erreurs.dossier-introuvable: This folder does not exist, or it is not yours.
erreurs.deplacement-circulaire: A folder cannot go into itself or into one of its subfolders.
erreurs.dossier-non-vide: This folder is not empty: move or delete its contents first.
erreurs.dernier-gestionnaire: A team always keeps at least one manager.
erreurs.deplacement-impossible: A document cannot go straight from one team to another: move it to My documents first.
erreurs.equipe-introuvable: This team does not exist, or you are not a member.
erreurs.equipe-non-vide: This team is not empty: move or delete its documents and folders first.
erreurs.reserve-administrateur: Reserved for the administrators of this instance.
erreurs.modele-introuvable: This template does not exist, or is not allowed for this document.
erreurs.reglage-inconnu: This setting cannot be changed in a team template.
erreurs.reglage-hors-bornes: A value is outside the allowed limits: check the settings.
erreurs.margo-indisponible: Margo is unavailable at the moment.
erreurs.selection-absente: Select the passage to correct first.
erreurs.demande-invalide: This request is empty, or too long ({max, number} characters, including spaces, at most).
erreurs.modele-sans-cle: This model has no key configured on this server.

suivi.aCheval: In Suggest mode, a deletion cannot cross the end of a paragraph (it would be recorded wrongly). Delete paragraph by paragraph, or switch to Edit.
suivi.miseEnForme: In Suggest mode, formatting is not suggested (it could not be accepted). Switch to Edit to change it.
suivi.panne: This document cannot be shown with its suggestions. Reload the page; if it happens again, report it.
suivi.panneRepli: Showing suggestions failed on this document: back to Edit.

suggestions.titre: {n, plural, =0 {No suggestions} one {# suggestion} other {# suggestions}}
suggestions.invisibles: Some suggestions are not shown in the list (a paragraph deletion, for instance): “Accept all” and “Reject all” still handle them.
suggestions.enAttente: Suggestions are waiting: switch to review to accept or reject them.

courriel.copier: If the link does not open, copy this address into your browser:
courriel.apres: This email was sent by amend.ink. If you were not expecting it, ignore it.

connexion.intro: Here is your link to sign in to amend.ink. It works once and for 15 minutes.

invitation.intro: {auteur} invites you to the document “{titre}” as {role}. The link is valid for 7 days.

acces.intro: {auteur} gave you access to the document “{titre}” as {role}.
{auteur} added you to the team “{equipe}” on amend.ink, as {role}.

invitation.sujet: {auteur} invites you to a team on amend.ink
invitation.intro: {auteur} invites you to the team “{equipe}”, as {role}. The link is valid for 7 days.

nom.explication: What name should others see in shared documents?

documents.confirmerRetrait: You will lose access to this document. Continue?
documents.confirmerDepart: You will lose access to the documents of the team “{nom}”. Continue?
documents.confirmerEntree: “{titre}” will belong to the team “{equipe}”: its members will have access, and its owners will become editors. Continue?
documents.confirmerSortie: “{titre}” will go to My documents and you will own it; team members without their own access will lose it. Continue?
documents.aucun: No document yet. Create the first one with “New document”.

telephone.lienNonCopie: The link could not be copied: {lien}

interface.modificationsCorrecteur: Your suggestions go to the document’s editors, who accept or reject them.
interface.horsLigne: Offline: your changes are kept and will be sent when the connection is back.

export.retenir: Keep this template for the document

modeles.aucun: The team has no template of its own yet.
modeles.detail: Based on “{titre}” · {n, plural, =0 {no document} one {# document} other {# documents}}
modeles.confirmerSuppression: Delete the template “{nom}”? {n, plural, =0 {No document uses it.} one {The document that used it will take the team default template.} other {The # documents that used it will take the team default template.}}

chapitre.bellePage: Chapters start on a right-hand page

margo.accueil: Ask Margo to proofread, correct or comment on the text. Corrections arrive as suggestions, in Changes, to accept or reject.

enCours.repli: The model declined this request. Margo is resuming it with another model…

margo.bilan: {corrections, plural, =0 {No corrections} one {# correction} other {# corrections}}, {commentaires, plural, =0 {no comments} one {# comment} other {# comments}}.

arret.etapes: Request stopped: too many steps. Try again on a shorter passage.
arret.refusEnSerie: Request stopped: too many rejected proposals in a row.
arret.longueur: Answer cut off: it was too long.
arret.erreur: Margo could not finish the request. What was posted stays in Changes.
